reason: Probe t7 ran kernel.run against kernel.reference (the direct modular DFT) on legal inputs across the full declared domain: N=64 and N=128, batches 1/3/128, random canonical field values plus extreme-value rows. Exact-integer comparison (contract requires abs/rel tolerance 0) showed mismatches on essentially every element: w64_b1 64/64, w64_b128 8191/8192, w128_b1 128/128, w128_b128 16381/16384 mismatched, plus extreme rows 128/128 and 255/256. Output dtype/shape/device/canonical range were correct but the values are wrong, so the kernel violates the contract's exact-match requirement. Secondary claim c2 (contiguous views with nonzero storage offset) was tested by probe t10 and rebutted — the kernel reads the view memory correctly; the mismatch there is the same value bug. Verdict: reject based on confirmed in-scope claim c1.
